top_call_exchanges.topic: Contract Pruning Strategy & Gross Margin Trough
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you walk through the decision to exit certain negative gross margin contracts? Is 34% the trough for gross margin, and how quickly does it rebound toward 50%?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Keyvan Mohajer (CEO): 'When we acquired Amelia and earlier assets, some legacy customer commitments carried negative economics. We made the disciplined decision not to renew those contracts. That creates a minor short-term revenue drag, but it immediately clears our path to sustained gross margins above 50% and positive EBITDA by second half 2027.'

top_call_exchanges.question: Operating cash burn rose to -$96M this quarter, leaving $207.6M in cash. Do you have sufficient liquidity to reach your 2H 2027 profitability milestone without dilutive capital raises?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Nitesh Sharan (CFO): 'Yes, absolutely. The Q3 cash burn included one-time transaction fees, severance costs, and working capital timing from our acquisitions. With $80M in synergy actions hitting before year-end, our quarterly cash burn will drop precipitously in Q4 and through 2027. We do not need outside financing.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: OASYS Agentic AI Platform & Enterprise Demand
top_call_exchanges.question: How are customers responding to OASYS, and does the shift to a hosted recurring model change your sales cycle length?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Keyvan Mohajer: 'OASYS shifts us from episodic upfront software licenses to predictable monthly recurring revenue. Our agentic voice models can now perform multi-step transactional tasks—like booking service appointments or processing complex food orders—fully autonomously. Enterprise pipeline is at an all-time high.'
